26.description: This vector represents common suffixes and endings in Hindi words written in the Devanagari script.

33.description: This feature vector activates strongly on specific Devanagari consonant-vowel conjuncts involving the letter 'ष' (sha).

143.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi words containing the consonant 'स' (sa) and related sub-word tokens.

179.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes, sub-word syllables, and phonetic fragments ending in the retroflex 'टर' or dental 'तर' sound.

93.description: This vector represents Hindi character sub-word tokens and conjunct consonants.

40.description: This vector activates for Hindi Devanagari characters and subword suffixes.

101.description: This vector activates on Hindi script characters and Devanagari Unicode sequences.

199.description: This vector activates on various non-English characters, particularly Hindi script fragments, alongside distinct English suffix components and proper noun prefixes.

153.description: These tokens represent Hindi verb suffixes and inflections related to gender, tense, and aspect.

117.description: These tokens represent dependent vowel signs (matras) and diacritics used in North Indic scripts like Hindi and Devanagari.
